title: When the Gravity Falls
author: Lior Brightwater
blurb: Zephyrine Thornbury, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
